title: Marris Stead
wikitext:
[[image:marris.jpg|right|thumb|Marris Stead]]
'''The Marris Stead''' rests atop a small ridge in the [[Eastern Plaguelands]] near the border of the [[Western Plaguelands]]. It is the long time family home of [[Nathanos Blightcaller|Nathanos Marris the Blightcaller]], who still makes the stead his home, despite being one with the [[Forsaken]] and hunted by the [[Alliance]].
